content: 1. Homatropine is not available as a single agent; it is only found in combination products. 2. Pramlintide and homatropine exhibit pharmacodynamic synergism, leading to increased effects of each other. This combination is contraindicated due to synergistic inhibition of gastrointestinal (GI) motility. 3. Homatropine, when used with umeclidinium bromide/vilanterol inhaled, may increase the toxicity of either drug through pharmacodynamic synergism. It is recommended to avoid this combination or use an alternative drug. Concurrent use with other anticholinergic-containing drugs may result in additive anticholinergic adverse effects. 4. Homatropine enhances the effects of abobotulinumtoxinA via pharmacodynamic synergism. Caution and monitoring are advised, as anticholinergic drugs may potentiate botulinum toxin effects, potentially causing excessive neuromuscular weakness and heightened systemic anticholinergic effects. 5.
